breadcrumb.text: Meet Our Doctors   Home > Dental > Dr Ho Wen Nee

doctor_profile_header.text: Dr Ho Wen Nee   Visiting ConsultantDental Surgery   Masters in Periodontology

doctor_biography.text: Dr Ho obtained her Bachelors of Dental Surgery from King’s College London in 2011, where she was awarded the Malleson Prize for outstanding research in the nal year. She then went on to obtain the Diploma of Membership of the Joint Dental Faculties at The Royal College of Surgeons of England and a Postgraduate Certicate in Advanced Aesthetic Dentistry from the Eastman Dental Institute. She spent four years working in and around London treating patients from all demographics on the National Health Service. Eventually her interest in the eld of periodontology brought her to Asia further her studies in the National University of Singapore, where she obtained her Masters in Periodontology in 2018. During her training she treated patients with complex dental needs at the National University Hospital and National Dental Center. Dr Ho now focuses on helping her patients achieve and maintain healthy gums, as part of their overall health. Her areas of interest include treatment of periodontal diseases, aesthetic gum concerns, and placement and treatment of implants. She is committed to lifelong learning and regularly attends conferences locally and overseas to keep up with developments in the eld of dentistry, and is an active member of the Singapore Periodontology Society and the International Team for Implantology.

breadcrumb.text: Meet Our Doctors   Home > Cardiology > Dr Patrick Ang

doctor_profile_header.text: Dr Patrick Ang   SENIOR CONSULTANT CARDIOLOGIST   MBBS (Singapore), MRCP (UK), FAMS (Singapore), FAPSIC

doctor_biography.text: Dr. Patrick Ang is a skilled cardiologist with expertise in a range of diagnostic and therapeutic procedures. He is a senior consultant cardiologist at Royal Healthcare Medical Centre. He graduated from the National University of Singapore with a MBBS in 1990 and became a member of the Royal College of Physicians (MRCP, UK) in 1995. His subspecialty is intervention cardiology, and he is fully registered and accredited by the Singapore Medical Council and the Ministry of Health. To date, he has performed over 20,000 angiograms and 10,000 angioplasties. He is a Fellow of the Academy of Medicine, Singapore (FAMS), a Fellow of the Asian Pacific Society of Intervention Cardiology (FAPSIC), member of the Singapore Cardiac Society and National Heart Association. In addition to his clinical expertise, he has written and published numerous original papers in various medical journals. He has also participated in many multicenter trials in intervention cardiology. As a highly respected senior cardiologist, Dr. Patrick has a proven track record of providing exceptional patient care and contributing significantly to research in the field.

breadcrumb.text: Meet Our Doctors   Home > Dental > Dr Jessalynn Sukamto

doctor_profile_header.text: Dr Jessalynn Sukamto   Visiting ConsultantDental Surgery   BBiomed (Biotechnology) DDS (Melbourne) MClinAud (Melbourne)

doctor_biography.text: Dr. Jessalynn Sukamto is a highly accomplished dental surgeon with a diverse academic background. She graduated from the University of Melbourne with degrees in Biotechnology, Dentistry, and Audiology, earning multiple accolades, including first-class honours, a place on the Dean’s Honours list, and recognition as valedictorian. Dr. Sukamto has extensive experience in dentistry, having worked in several clinics across Australia and Singapore. She currently serves as a Professional Mentor at the University of Melbourne and was recently appointed as a Council Member of the Singapore Dental Association. Dr. Sukamto is renowned for her gentle and holistic approach to dentistry, with a strong emphasis on preventive care. She excels in aesthetic dentistry and oral surgery, adeptly managing patients with dental phobias as well as special needs. Committed to lifelong learning, Dr. Sukamto is involved in organising global dental conferences and stays up to date with the latest advances in dentistry. She is registered with both the Australian Health Practitioners Dental Board (AHPRA) and the Singapore Dental Council, ensuring the highest standards of care.

doctor_profile_header.text: Dr Donovan Tay Yu-kwang   Visiting Consultant Endocrinology   MBBS(Singapore), MRCP (UK), M.Med (Singapore), FAMS (Endocrinology)

doctor_biography.text: Dr Tay Yu Kwang Donovan is a Visiting Consultant in Endocrinology in Department of General Medicine at Sengkang General Hospital . He completed his basic specialist training and obtained the Membership of the Royal College of Physicians MRCP (UK), as well as his Master of Medicine (Singapore) in 2010. Dr Tay received further advanced specialist training in Endocrinology and was certified by the Specialists Accreditation Board of Singapore in 2013. He further undertook his fellowship and research training in Metabolic Bone Disease and Osteoporosis at the Metabolic Bone Disease Unit, Division of Endocrinology, Department of Medicine, College of Physician and Surgeons, Columbia University (New York, USA) in 2016. Dr Tan’s clinical expertise includes management of metabolic bone disease, in addition to common hormonal problems. He runs a calcium and bone clinic at Sengkang General Hospital managing patients with primary hyperparathyroidism, chronic hypoparathyroidism and osteoporosis.

breadcrumb.text: Meet Our Doctors   Home > Obstetrics & Gynaecology > Dr Tay Eng Hseon

doctor_profile_header.text: Dr Tay Eng Hseon   Visiting ConsultantObstetrics & Gynaecology   MBBS (Singapore), MRCOG (UK), FRCOG (London), MMED (O&G) (Singapore), FAMS (Singapore), Certificate in Gynaecological Oncology DGO (RANZCOG)

doctor_biography.text: Dr Tay Eng Hseon is a Senior Consultant Gynaecologist at the Royal Women’s Cancer Centre & Pelvic Surgery. Dr Tay offers a comprehensive range of services focused on gynaecological pre-cancer, tumours, and cancers, managing conditions such as Cervical Intra-epithelial Neoplasia (CIN), Vaginal Intra-epithelial Neoplasia (VAIN), and Vulvar Intra-epithelial Neoplasia (VIN). He specialises in treating tumours of the ovary, uterus, cervix, vagina, and vulva. His expertise also includes managing Gestational Trophoblastic Diseases, conducting cancer screenings, and administering HPV vaccinations for cervical cancer prevention. Dr Tay is skilled in advanced procedures such as colposcopy and biopsy, cone biopsy, LEEP surgery, laser surgery, and laparoscopic surgery. Dr Tay is also a Gynaecological and Oncological Associate Professor with numerous qualifications and accolades in Obstetrics & Gynaecology from prestigious institutions worldwide. With over three decades of experience, he has held pivotal roles in healthcare establishments across Singapore and Australia, establishing himself as a respected authority in the medical community. Notably, Dr Tay served as the former Chairman of the Medical Board and Head of Gynaecological Oncology Services at KK Women’s and Children’s Hospital. His expertise and surgical proficiency in addressing gynaecological cancers have garnered significant recognition within Singapore and the broader region. Beyond his clinical roles, Dr Tay has held positions in prestigious medical organisations, reflecting his commitment to advancing the field. He has been a Founding Member and Honorary Treasurer of the Asia Oceania Organisation of Genital Tract Infection & Neoplasia (AOGIN) and served as Chairman of Gynaecological Oncology for the Asia Oceania Federation of Obstetrics and Gynaecology (AOFOG) from 2007 to 2011. He was Chairman of Gynaecological Oncology at the College of O&G Singapore from 2007 to 2009 and a Clinical Associate Professor at the National University of Singapore from 2005 to 2009. Dr. Tay also served as Chairman of the Medical Board and Head of the Department of Gynaecological Subspecialties at KK Women’s & Children’s Hospital from 2004 and led the Gynaecological Oncology department from 2002 to 2004. Dr Tay’s expertise and dedication to women’s health make him a key figure in gynaecological and oncological care. His experience and commitment to advancing medical practices underscore his invaluable contributions to both his patients and the medical community. Dr Tay is accredited to perform surgical procedures at Thomson Medical Centre.

breadcrumb.text: Meet Our Doctors   Home > Men’s Health > Dr Matthew Tan Chong Yang

doctor_profile_header.text: Dr Matthew Tan Chong Yang   VISITING CONSULTANTMEN’S HEALTH   BSc (Hons)(Singapore), MBBS (Sydney), Singapore Men's Health Society (Member), Singapore Association for the Study of Obesity (Member)

doctor_biography.text: Dr Matthew Tan graduated from the University of Sydney Medical School in 2015, prior to which he obtained a Honors Degree in Life Sciences from the National University of Singapore in 2011.He was awarded the Ministry of Health Pre-Employment Grant and returned to Singapore to serve at the 2 major tertiary institutes in Singapore – Singapore General Hospital (SGH) and the National University Health System (NUHS). The majority of his time in the public service was spent in the Pediatric Surgery department which was where he developed his interest in Circumcision techniques for the best aesthetic outcomes. In addition to Pediatric Surgery, Matthew rotated through a range surgical subspecialty including Hepatobiliary Surgery, Vascular Surgery, Breast Surgery and Trauma Surgery. He has a keen interest in research and continually stays up to date with the latest developments in patient care. He continues to contribute to research by publishing articles and reviewing for academic journals and has presented his work at both local and international conferences. Matthew is a firm proponent for inclusivity in healthcare and believes that everyone deserve the opportunity to understand their medical condition and work with their doctors to achieve their health goals.

breadcrumb.text: Meet Our Doctors   Home > Neurology > Dr Mohammed Tauqeer Ahmad

doctor_profile_header.text: Dr Mohammed Tauqeer Ahmad   Visiting Consultant Neurologist   MBBS (Aligarh Muslim U, India) MRCP (UK) (RCP, United Kingdom) M Med (Int Med) (NUS, Singapore) MRCPS (RCPS, Glasgow, United Kingdom) FAMS (Neurology) (Academy of Medicine, Singapore) FRCPEd (RCP, Edinburgh, United Kingdom)

doctor_biography.text: Dr Mohammad Tauqeer Ahmad is a neurologist practising at Gleneagles Hospital, Singapore. He has a special interest in strokes, epilepsy movement disorders and neuroimmunology. He has experience in treating strokes with neuro-intervention. Dr Ahmad graduated from the Aligarh Muslim University (AMU), India and later became a member of the Royal College of Physicians, London. He pursued his masters in internal medicine in National University of Singapore (NUS) and received his fellowship from the Royal College of Physicians of Edinburgh, UK. Furthermore, he has a fellowship from the Academy of Medicine, Singapore in neurology and internal medicine, as well as membership of the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Glasgow. After completing his residency from AMU, he joined Singapore General Hospital (SGH) as a medical officer and worked in multiple departments such as internal medicine, haematology, cardiology and neurology. He then moved on to become a registrar at the National Neuroscience Institute (SGH) and completed his basic and advanced training at SGH. He was also a clinical tutor at NUS’ Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine. Dr Ahmad is actively involved in post-graduate and undergraduate medical training, as well as in imparting knowledge to allied healthcare workers and the public. He is an active participant in local committees and a reviewer to many peer-reviewed journals related to neurology. He has also published papers in journals such as Movement Disorders and the Annals of Indian Academy of Neurology. He has also participated in many media interviews and public awareness programmes to share his experience and knowledge with the local public on his expertise in stroke management and neurology in general. Throughout his medical career, Dr Ahmad has achieved many awards and recognition for his work in the medical landscape in Singapore, such as the Best Medical Officer Award (SGH), Service Quality Partners Award, Service with Gold Award and Service with a Heart Award.

breadcrumb.text: Meet Our Doctors   Home > All Doctors > Dr Michael Lim

doctor_profile_header.text: Dr Michael Lim   Medical DirectorSenior Consultant Physician / Cardiologist   MBBS, MRCP(UK), M MED(Int Med), FAMS(Cardiology), FRCP(Edin)

doctor_biography.text: Dr Michael Lim is an internationally renown interventional cardiologist with extensive experience in computerized tomography (CT) imaging of the heart arteries. He was also sent for a fellowship in Angiography and Interventional Radiology/Cardiology in the USA. He also has a Master of Medicine (Internal Medicine) from National University of Singapore and completed his UK internal medicine examinations and was made a Member of the Royal Colleges of Physicians of the United Kingdom. He is currently the Medical Director of the Royal Healthcare Heart, Stroke and Cancer Centre, Board Member of the Chapter of Cardiology of the Academy of Medicine in Singapore, Vice-Chairman of the World Association of Chinese Doctors, Vice-Chairman of the World Association of Chinese Cardiologists, International Advisor of the Asia Pacific Society of Cardiology, Founding Editor of Heart Asia (British Medical Journals) and Visiting Consultant to Singapore National Heart Centre, Mount Elizabeth Hospital, Gleneagles Hospital, Parkway East Hospital, Mount Elizabeth Novena Hospital and Mount Alvernia Hospital. He was appointed as Honorary President of the Asian Society of Cardiology in December 2018 and was appointed Honorary Professor and Senior Medical Advisor of the Peking University Heart Center in 2008. He has served as President of Asian Pacific Society of Cardiology , Dean of the College of the Asian Pacific Society of Cardiology, Board Member of the World Heart Federation (WHF) , President of the Singapore Cardiac Society, Advisory Board Member of the Asia Pacific Society of Interventional Cardiology, Editor-in-Chief of Heart Asia ( a journal of the prestigious British Medical Journals) and Visiting Adjunct Professor of Min Hang Hospital of Fudan University in Shanghai. He is also one of 10 global recipients and the only physician in South East Asia who was awarded “THE WORLD OUTSTANDING CHINESE DOCTOR AWARD – THE FOK YING TUNG PRIZE”, the highest recognition given to medical doctors of Chinese ethnicity , by the World Association of Chinese Doctors.

breadcrumb.text: Meet Our Doctors   Home > Aesthetics > Dr Francis Tjang

doctor_profile_header.text: Dr Francis Tjang   Aesthetics DoctorTHE AESTHETICS MEDICAL CLINIC   MBBS  (Australia),GDFM (Singapore), DFD  (Singapore), Dip Aesthetic Med(USA)

doctor_biography.text: Dr. Francis Tjang received his Bachelor of Medicine from University of New South Wales in 1982, followed by his postgraduate medical qualifications in Family Medicine from both National University of Singapore and College of Family Physicians Singapore. Armed with years of invaluable medical experience and a keen interest in aesthetics and cosmetic dermatology, Dr Francis Tjang obtained his aesthetics qualification from the American Academy of Aesthetic Medicine (USA) in 2006. Dr. Francis Tjang is passionate in:  Non-Surgical Skin Rejuvenation for Pre-mature skin aging Pigmentation Removal with Laser Treatments Acne and Acne Scar Treatments Skin Injectable Such as Rejuran, Profhilo, Fillers and Botox. Fat Removal and Weight Management  Through out the years, Dr. Tjang has travelled multiple times a year for for Medical Cosmetic Conferences, Aesthetic Medicine Training and Fellowship, Plastic Surgery and Liposuction training in Korea, Milan, USA, Taiwan, Belgium, Malaysia, Bangkok since he started his own practice, Orchard Medical Centre in 2007. He is currently the medical director of The Aesthetics Medical Clinic since 2014. Dr. Francis Tjang is awarded “Expert Hands” Title for the Rejuran Treatment by Rejuran in KOREA since 2017.

breadcrumb.text: Meet Our Doctors   Home > Radiology > Dr Lau Chin Wah

doctor_profile_header.text: Dr Lau Chin Wah   ConsultantRadiologist   MBBS (Au.), FRCR

doctor_biography.text: Dr Lau Chin Wah graduated from the Monash University of Australia in 2007. He joined the restructured public hospital sector in Singapore in 2008 for his medical rotations in various clinical disciplines. Subsequently, he received his radiology specialist training with the Singhealth Diagnostic Radiology Residency before attaining his fellowship from the Royal College of Radiologists, London in 2016. He then embarked on specialist practice as a Consultant in the Department of Radiology, Ng Teng Fong General Hospital. During his time as consultant radiologist, he was in charge of various departmental roles including interdepartmental rounds, hospital clinical care review and radiology department risk management. He was also active in academic roles as a clinical lecturer of the Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine National University of Singapore and NUHS Radiology Residency tutor. He is a member of the Singapore Medical Association and Singapore Radiological Society.

breadcrumb.text: Meet Our Doctors   Home > Internal Medicine > Dr Chong Yeh Woei

doctor_profile_header.text: Dr Chong Yeh Woei   Senior Consultant Physician (Internal Medicine)   MBBS (Singapore), MRCP (Internal Medicine)

doctor_biography.text: Dr Chong Yeh Woei is a senior consultant physician in the Royal Healthcare Specialists Centre. With more than 20 years of experience in the private practice of internal medicine, he manages a wide spectrum of medical ailments. He is compassionate; he listens and addresses the concerns of his patients and their family members. His smile is his trademark while his knowledge and compassion gives his patients confidence and assurance. Dr Chong is the Chairman of the Singapore Medical Association Charity Fund. He has been a SMA Council Member since 1998. He was the SMA President from 2009 to 2012. He is the Chairman of the MOH Medical Advisory Panel on Driving. He represents the SMA on the SMC CME Coordinating Committee. He is also the Chairman of the Confederation of Medical Associations of Asia and the Oceania (CMAAO) of which the SMA is a member. He is also a member of the SMA-IDA Ikatan Dokter Indonesia (Indonesian Medical Association) Joint Committee (MOU on Publicity Guidelines and Code of Ethics on Hospital Promotion).

breadcrumb.text: Meet Our Doctors   Home > Renal Medicine > Dr. Behram Ali Khan

doctor_profile_header.text: Dr. Behram Ali Khan   Senior Consultant Nephrologist & Asst Professor of Medicine   American Board Certified

doctor_biography.text: Dr. Behram Ali Khan is a Senior Consultant Nephrologist and Asst Professor of Medicine.  He received his training in USA and is American Board Certified in Nephrology and Internal Medicine, with Singapore Medical Council accreditation in Renal Medicine.  He has over 25 years of experience in the medical field and has served in various leadership positions.  Dr Behram continues his medical practice at both public and private sectors in Singapore and his Teaching/Research activities at National University of Singapore and Duke-NUS. Dr. Behram has a keen interest in Chronic Disease management, Kidney Diseases, Hypertension, Diabetes, Obesity, Longevity Medicine, Internal Medicine disorders, Dialysis and Acute Kidney injuries.  He also performs Interventional Nephrology procedures. His specialty interests are medical disorders, kidney disease, hypertension, diabetes, dialysis, interventional nephrology  procedures, chronic disease management, obesity and longevity medicine.

breadcrumb.text: Meet Our Doctors   Home > Cardiology > Dr Kelvin Wong

doctor_profile_header.text: Dr Kelvin Wong   Visiting Consultant Cardiologist   BSc (Hons, UK), MB BChir (Cambridge), MD (Cambridge), MRCP (UK)

doctor_biography.text: Dr Wong did his undergraduate training at University of Cambridge and St Bartholomew’s and the Royal London School of Medicine and Dentistry, UK, from 1994 to 1999. He was awarded Distinction in Medicine and received several undergraduate prizes. He was also awarded First Class Honours and Distinction award for Bachelor of Science degree in Neuroscience at University College London in 1997. Post-graduation, he obtained his MRCP (UK) in 2003 and was conferred the Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) degree by University of Cambridge in 2013. He started training in the field of Cardiology at the Wessex Deanery (UK) in 2003. He undertook sub-specialty training in Cardiac Electrophysiology and Cardiac Rhythm Management in 2007. From 2008 to 2010, he was appointed the Research Fellow for Electrophysiology at the John Radcliffe Hospital, Oxford, UK. His research work on atrial fibrillation ablation was submitted as a thesis for his Doctorate degree to University of Cambridge. He underwent further training as the Senior Electrophysiology Fellow at Oxford before obtaining his Certificate of Completion of Training (CCT) in Cardiology and General (Internal) Medicine in 2011. He was then appointed as Locum Consultant at John Radcliffe Hospital, Oxford University Hospitals NHS Trust, in 2012. Dr Wong returned to Singapore in 2014 as Consultant Cardiologist at Changi General Hospital and visiting Consultant to National Heart Centre Singapore. He was instrumental in helping to develop the Electrophysiology service at Changi General Hospital. He helped set up specialised clinics such as the Inherited Cardiac Conditions clinic and the Atrial Fibrillation clinic. He is experienced in treating patients with cardiac arrhythmia. He is competent in performing device implantations (pacemaker, defibrillator) and complex ablations for arrhythmia. He continues to offer proctorship services to countries such as Malaysia, India and Vietnam.
